prompt:
Use case: logo-brand / mascot character.
Create the official mascot "Fit" for CODE:FIT, a friendly Korean learning service that helps beginners understand apps and developers understand AI-generated code. One full-body character, no text, no wordmark, no presentation sheet.
Design: a tiny friendly terminal companion. Squat pear-shaped white body with two short sturdy white feet, no fingers. A large gently rounded-square white head containing a BLACK terminal-screen face. Two chunky WHITE square eyes and one very simple short white horizontal underscore mouth on the screen. An original detached small white rounded square floats just above the head's upper-right corner like a cursor, echoing CODE:FIT's C-and-square logo. One small white mitten arm waves gently toward the viewer; the other rests near its body. Curious and approachable, calm, not babyish. Character has distinctive asymmetrical silhouette because of the wave and cursor. Head/body are visually connected, no thin neck. Maximum simplicity, no chest badges or buttons, no cables, no headphones, no antenna stalk, no letters.
Style: polished flat 2D brand mascot, clean rounded bold geometry, crisp vector-like edges; PURE BLACK and WHITE only, neutral grey edge antialiasing allowed. No purple or colored tint, no gradients, no texture, no glow, no 3D, no drop shadow, no shiny toy material.
Composition: 1024x1024 square, solid opaque pure black #000000 background, no transparency. Centered full character occupies about 78% height, all feet and wave visible with generous margins. White character must remain legible as a 56px chat launcher. Deliver final usable image asset.
